key_insight: A closed-loop optimizer calibrates atomistic Kinetic Monte Carlo reaction rates directly from experimental GaAs growth data, reducing reliance on costly DFT calculations.
engineering_relevance: The framework turns routine deposition measurements into a mechanistically interpretable model that could support MOCVD process optimization.
method: Simulate thin-film growth using atomistic Kinetic Monte Carlo.
Use Monte Carlo Tree Search to calibrate kinetic rate parameters against experimental growth data.
Guide parameter search using each reaction’s degree of rate control.
evidence_signal: For GaAs MOCVD, the calibrated model captures the measured growth-rate dependence on temperature and recovers three known kinetic regimes with changing rate-determining steps.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish parameter uniqueness or predictive accuracy outside the calibration conditions.
paper_title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
